schema_version.description: Version of the file format. CloudScope migrates older files automatically.

level.description: Messages below this level are dropped.

console.description: Write log lines to standard error.

file.description: Write log lines to cloudscope.log in the log folder.

directory.description: Log folder. Empty: the standard folder for this platform.

max_file_mb.description: A log file is rotated when it would grow beyond this size.

max_files.description: Number of log files kept: the current one plus rotated ones.

uvc.description: Offer the computer's USB video cameras and built-in webcams (UVC) as devices.

simulation.description: Simulated devices for working and testing without hardware.

enabled.description: Offer simulated devices next to real ones. Their data is always labelled as simulated.

seed.description: The same seed gives the same clouds and the same sensor noise.

replay_folder.description: Folder of JPEG or PNG pictures shown by the replay camera in name order. Empty: no replay camera.

replay_fps.description: Pictures per second of the replay camera.
